description.value: Red Tomato Pies is a BC-born pizza chain founded in Williams Lake by Jason and Amber Akeson, now operating 11 locations across Western Canada. The Fort St. John location offers a broad menu of handcrafted pizzas, pasta, wings, salads, and desserts with takeout and delivery. The chain has earned a reputation for quality pizza and offers notable dietary flexibility including plant-based and gluten-free options.
